Remark
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0016 1. Remark 1.5\group three-manifolds

A complete proof of the Elliptization Conjecture would imply the Poincaré Conjecture, which asserts that any homotopy $3$-sphere is actually a topological $3$-sphere.
